presence_rationale: Topic addressed via Climate and Environment Strategy (Board-approved Oct 2024) with explicit 'Transitioning our lending portfolio to net-zero financed emissions' as one of three core ambitions. Pointer to companion 2024 Climate-related Financial Disclosures document.
specificity_rationale: Strategy framework named (three-ambition Climate Strategy with divisional action plans starting 2025: Institutional, Commercial, Retail, NZ). Glossary of Net-zero, Sectoral pathways, Paris Agreement, Transition plan. KPMG provides reasonable assurance over operational Scope 1/2/3 — but the SASB FN-CB-410b focus (financed emissions) is mostly deferred to the Climate-related Financial Disclosures, not this supplement.
quantification_rationale: Operational targets quantified (Scope 1+2 80% reduction since 2015, 57% renewable electricity in 2024 — short of 100% target). However, the SASB FN-CB-410b metrics (absolute Scope 1/2/3 financed emissions, gross exposure by industry, % covered, methodology) are NOT in retrieved evidence — they live in the separate 2024 Climate-related Financial Disclosures and Financed Emissions Methodology documents.
